name: RSVPify Event RSVP & Registration Embed
author: RSVPify

sections.description: Easily embed your event’s online RSVP or event registration form on any page or post to allow guests to seamlessly RSVP from any WordPress-powered website. Guests can RSVP, register for your event, or purchase tickets without leaving your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rsvpify-embedder folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to RSVPify Embedder in the admin menu to generate your shortcode.
  4. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or Elementor Shortcode/Text widget.
  5. Save and view your page—your RSVPify form will appear.
sections.faq:
How do I embed my RSVPify RSVP or registration form?

Use the RSVPify Embedder plugin to generate a shortcode like:

[rsvpify_form url="https://yourevent.rsvpify.com"]

Place that shortcode in any page/post or Shortcode/Text widget.

What is RSVPify?

RSVPify lets event hosts quickly create custom online RSVP and registration forms. You can accept RSVPs, sell tickets, and manage guest lists all in one place.

Is RSVPify free?

RSVPify is free for events with up to 100 RSVPs or registrants. Premium plans and one-time event plans are also available.

screenshots.caption:
Seamless RSVP Management
Instantly view and manage your guest list’s RSVP statuses, customize invitation styling (colors, background, logos), and publish updates without leaving your WordPress dashboard.

Effortless Registration & Ticketing
Let guests select meal options and secure their tickets right on your site with our intuitive, on-page registration form—no redirects required.

Pixel-Perfect Embeds
Watch RSVPify blend beautifully into your site’s theme. Our embeds auto-scale and inherit your design, so every “RSVP” button looks native and on-brand.
